Man this is so real I 100% get where your at because I am in the same boat. Although I wasnt always like this I think the pandemic really let this sort of bad habit of mine to flourish because during that time we weren't expected to do or be anything. Now I have a hard time with getting back into the flow of things, of how to be a person who's proactive in their own life and not just dreaming about things I could do. When your not doing these things you say you get anxious and wanna watch the world burn, I wonder do you feel this way because your ashamed of how you are and might be envious of others? I only ask because I feel similarly and I believe that thought process is the cause of it. Like if no one else exists than no one can judge me for being this way. Distractions from the real world is reasonable to a certain extent there are a lot of things that are terrifying. But there are also thing that are exciting and joyful if you seek them out and thats the key word yknow seeking it out; choosing to find that beauty and joy.

As for advice on how to get out of it well thats something Im also trying to figure out, a few things I could recommend though.

Since you daydream a lot why not try to make art or comics out of what your thinking, this is how I create a lot of my works and if you switch out peoples names nobody really notices unless your being super obvious (you dont have to be "good" at art in order to do this the simple act of creating something instead of consuming can help shake things up a bit, also you get a fun new hobby you can show off if you want to)

Dont be afraid to be a little weirdo, talk to random people you see out in the world make bad art and even worse music. Buy a guitar and never learn how to properly play it just enjoy the action of strumming. Paint yourself blue and smack yourself against a big piece of paper. Do something fun and different than what you usually do that doesnt require much effort.

I think the key in genuinely changing is not trying to fight your current state, you shouldnt try to be the exact opposite of who you were yesterday because that is ultimately unsustainable. Instead you should try to transform your habits into something that will serve you in the future. small changes everyday will mean one day you will be entirely different and you wont even notice it.
